notes: The head of ἱερατείαν is taken as office on rule 66's gloss test; priest's is the competing reading and is named in the unit note.
τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν is rule 20 proper: the genitive pronoun is free, so it takes their and the article realizes nothing.
οἱ … λαμβάνοντες splits under rule 32 with two English words written, they and that receive, unlike the single-relativizer articles of 7:1 and 7:9.
